name: Harken & Solé Artisan Pull-On Boot
description:
A tall pull-on boot built on a last shaped to the individual buyer's foot scan — Harken & Solé takes no walk-in orders. The shaft is genuine buffalo leather, sourced from one of three remaining licensed herds, stitched in a traditional twelve-row pattern. The heel is stacked leather, low and square. No hardware. No tech. Just craft.

This is what Tier 5 residents wear when they want to look like they don't care about impressing anyone. Which is, of course, the most expensive impression of all.
what_it_says: You waited four months for these and paid for a foot scan appointment. You are beyond trends.
worn_by: off-duty executives who want to look casual
story_hooks: Harken & Solé keeps every foot scan on file. Someone has accessed the database — every Tier 5 client's biometric data, freely available.
A pair shows up on a Tier 2 resale rack. The boot still has the original owner's name embossed inside. That person was reported dead six months ago.
